# 00000002756

**PI-16 ★** — source: 77_非交换多项式恒等_PI理论.md

**English.** Definition: *-identities of matrix algebras: PI with involution. Conjecture: The classification of involution identities: the *-T-ideal of M_n with transpose involution is generated by two families of symmetric/antisymmetric identities, with minimal degree of the generating family a split correction of 2n. (involution PI minimal generation degree)

**中文。** 定义：矩阵代数的 *-恒等式：带对合的 PI。猜想：对合恒等式的分类：M_n 带转置对合的 *-T-理想由两族对称/反对称恒等式生成且生成族的极小度为 2n 的分裂修正。（对合 PI 极小生成度）
